<!-- Title: feat(edgeless): start a connector by hovering a shape's anchors -->
<!-- Open from: spmp:pr/06-connector-hover-initiation (generated by tools/stack-publish; one commit on pr/05-connector-core) -->

## Description

Hovering a shape shows its connection anchors. Dragging from an anchor starts
a connector at that point, without picking the connector tool first.

- Only the shape under the pointer shows anchors.
- Typing in notes is not affected.
- *Settings → Connector → Hover to initiate* turns it off.

![Demo](https://spmp.github.io/affine-pr-docs/assets/images/pr-06/hero.webp)

Full write-up and testing notes: https://spmp.github.io/affine-pr-docs/pr-06/
